# lambda_rtklib_oracle fixture

- `rtklib_lambda_driver.c`: the driver that generates the 300 integer least-squares problems and
  runs RTKLIB's `lambda()` on them. Its header gives the build and run commands.
- `rtklib_lambda_reference.txt`: the driver's output (inputs as exact integers and 17-digit floats,
  RTKLIB's two best integer candidates and their squared norms). Generated 2026-10-01.

Oracle: RTKLIB v2.4.2-p13, tag `v2.4.2-p13`, commit 71db0ffa0d9735697c6adfd06fdf766d0e5ce807,
https://github.com/tomojitakasu/RTKLIB, BSD-2-Clause, copyright T. Takasu. RTKLIB is compiled from
its own source as a separate tool and is not linked into or copied into the crate; only the numbers
it printed are committed here. On Linux, replace `-D_DARWIN_C_SOURCE` with `-D_GNU_SOURCE`.

The problems are synthetic (generated by the driver from a fixed seed); no third-party data is
included.
